name: Futago Hinyuu x 3
source:
3 refers to the three sets of twin princesses you’ll have under your power. To save you from the politics of the plot--which are both hard to translate and rather boring—I will just say that the three countries surrounding your kingdom are being jerks (or were you the first to be a jerk, who cares). Upon acquiring each set of twins, you’ll be able to train them in SLG style gameplay. If successful, you should at least have one foreign country at your beckon, but there has to be a way of getting all three.

[Vague Game Description by White Masq]
translation:
3指的是你将拥有的三对双胞胎公主。为了让你免于政治情节的影响——这既难以翻译又相当无聊——我只想说你王国周围的三个国家都是混蛋（或者你是第一个成为混蛋的人，谁在乎呢）。获得每对双胞胎后，你将能够在SLG风格的游戏中训练他们。如果成功的话，你至少应该拥有一个外国国家供你使用，但必须有一种方法来获得这三个国家。

[White Masq的模糊游戏描述]
